profile.headline: Web Developer at Shubert Organization
profile.summary:
Nearly a decade into my career, I am always looking for ways to push myself further and reach past what I currently believe is possible. Since I finished my studies in NJIT, I have had the pleasure of developing different automations, services, and websites for companies including NBCUniversal and The Shubert Organization. I am continuously striving to be a more well rounded person each day while also being able to contribute to my passion for the entertainment industries. I believe honing in on your trade and skills is similar to training for a marathon. Day in and day out, it is about putting your best foot forward and laying down the best of your efforts with enthusiasm, especially on the days that seem to be the hardest. The world is constantly changing and it is up to us to keep up with its pace.

Whether you want to collaborate on a new project or talk all things race day and marathon training, let's connect! Drop me a line here or my email sfgomez97@gmail.com.

projects.title: Tadu
projects.description: Tadu is an interactive checklist app that organizes the priorities of the users according to importance, due date, and labels. As of now, the app allows you input tasks into a database which you can access with the click of a button. However, after future work, the development team hopes to add a feature which increments the importance of tasks over time thus bringing older untouched tasks to the users' attention. Along with that, the team also hopes to add a mobile version of the app for android and apple devices in order to help people keep track of their lists where ever they go! Tadu is an app that will make you say "tada" when your "todo" lists become clear!

projects.title: Forecastr
projects.description:
• Developed a web application that tracks the weather in specified locations and alerts users when the weather of that location when the weather falls into a desired threshold
• Obtained live weather information using the Open-Weather-Map API
• Integrated RabbitMQ in order to distribute and queue messages amongst multiple servers
• Utilized: PHP, MySQL, RabbitMQ, Open-Weather-Map API, HTML/CSS, Javascript

organizations.name: NJIT's Filipinos in Newark Engaging Sociocultural Traditions
organizations.position: Vice President 2017 - 2018    •    External Public Relations Officer 2016 - 2017 · Sep 2015 - Present
organizations.description: Inspiring students in the NJIT community to embrace Filipino and Filipino-American culture while also establishing intercollegiate communications between Filipino organizations throughout the northern region of New Jersey and New York City. In  addition, I am responsible for coordinating various cultural and networking themed events in collaboration with organizations outside of the New Jersey Institute of Technology.
